part: main loop: Condition and direction, students
question: Do students on a small embedding of the headline plus teaser read the engine's stories better than students on word counts, with the same 20,000 queue labels?
one_change: replace word and character counts with the bge-small embedding (64 word pieces) as the student's input; same labels, same engine stories, same view

baseline.model: T112 students on word counts, same labels

prediction.metric: direction accuracy on the engine stories, headline view, largest training size
prediction.why: T112 word-count students gave 0.658 on this view (runs/pulse/t112/t112_students.json#headline_view_largest.direction_accuracy); an embedding generalises across wording, so presence AUROC is expected 0.72 to 0.79 against 0.7253 for word counts; direction may stay flat because the label is a small signal in the text
